meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂工作分解为循证步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望把模糊目标拆解成可执行、有依据的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex work into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to decompose vague goals into actionable, evidence-backed steps

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的长期目标拆成一个个细小的步骤，每步都要有真实结果（如命令输出、网页变化）为证；它用专门工具记录进度和检查点，必要时派其他AI帮手并行干活，按工作单元提交成果。
howto.when: 当你提到“ulw-loop”、“ulw”等关键词，或要求做持久目标执行等长期任务时触发。

say.text: 用ulw-loop帮我完成这个长期项目。
say.note: Claude 会开始拆解目标并逐步执行。

say.text: 用证据导向的方式跟踪这个任务。
say.note: 每步都会记录真实证据。

say.text: 启用持久目标执行，并定期人工质检。
say.note: Claude 会按检查点推进并汇报。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude splits long goals into tiny steps, each backed by real evidence. It tracks progress/checkpoints with a tool, spawns subagents when needed, and commits per work unit.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "ulw-loop", "ulw", or ask for persistent goal execution or similar long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to complete this long-term project.
say_en.note: Claude will break down the goal and proceed step by step.

say_en.text: Track this task in an evidence-led way.
say_en.note: Each step will record real evidence.

say_en.text: Enable persistent goal execution with periodic manual QA.
say_en.note: Claude will advance by checkpoints and report.
